source_text: Quis ergo sic est sceleratus et perfidus, quis sic discordiae furore vesanus, ut aut credat scindi posse aut audeat scindere unitatem Dei, vestem Domini, Ecclesiam Christi? Monet ipse in Evangelio suo et docet dicens: Et erit unus grex et unus pastor. Et esse posse uno in loco aliquis existimat aut multos pastores aut plures greges? Apostolus item Paulus, hanc eamdem nobis insinuans unitatem, obsecrat et hortatur dicens: Obsecro, inquit, vos, fratres, per nomen Domini nostri Jesu Christi, ut id ipsum dicatis omnes, et non sint in vobis schismata. Sitis autem compositi in eodem sensu et in eadem sententia. Et iterum dicit: Sustinentes invicem in dilectione, satis agentes servare unitatem spiritus in conjunctione pacis. Stare tu et vivere putas posse de Ecclesia recedentem, sedes sibi alias et diversa domicilia condentem, cum dictum sit ad Rahab, in qua praeformabatur Ecclesia: Patrem tuum et matrem tuam et fratres tuos et totam domum patris tui colliges ad te ipsam in domum tuam, et omnis qui exierit ostium domus tuae foras, reus sibi erit. Item sacramentum Paschae nihil aliud in Exodi lege contineat quam ut agnus, qui in figura Christi occiditur, in domo una edatur. Loquitur Deus dicens: In domo una comedetur, non ejicietis de domo carnem foras. Caro Christi et sanctum Domini ejici foras non potest, nec alia ulla credentibus praeter unam Ecclesiam domus est. Hanc domum, hoc unanimitatis hospitium designat et denuntiat Spiritus sanctus in Psalmis dicens: Deus qui inhabitare facit unanimes in domo. In domo Dei, in Ecclesia Christi, unanimes habitant, concordes et simplices perseverant.
pass_a_gloss: Who therefore is so wicked and faithless, who is so insane with the fury of discord, that he either believes that the unity of God can be torn apart or dares to tear apart the unity of God, the garment of the Lord, the Church of Christ? He himself warns and teaches in his Gospel, saying: And there will be one flock and one shepherd. And does anyone think that there can be one flock or many shepherds in one place? The Apostle Paul also, indicating this same unity to us, begs and exhorts, saying: I beg you, brothers, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you all say the same thing, and that there not be schisms among you. But be united in the same sense and in the same opinion. And again he says: Supporting one another in love, being sufficient to guard the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace. Do you think that one who departs from the Church and establishes other seats and different dwellings for himself can stand and live, when it was said to Rahab, in whom the Church was prefigured: Gather your father and your mother and your brothers and your whole father's household to yourself in your house, and everyone who goes out of the door of your house outside will be guilty. Likewise, the sacrament of the Passover contains nothing else in the law of Exodus than that the lamb, which is killed in the figure of Christ, is eaten in one house. God says: It will be eaten in one house, you will not throw the flesh outside the house. The flesh of Christ and the sacred thing of the Lord cannot be thrown outside, nor is there any other house for believers except the one Church. The Holy Spirit designates and announces this house, this hospitality of unity, saying in the Psalms: God who makes the like-minded dwell in a house. In the house of God, in the Church of Christ, the like-minded dwell, and they persevere, harmonious and simple.

pass_b_english: Who could be so wicked and faithless, so crazed by the fury of discord, that he either believes the unity of God can be torn apart or dares to tear it apart — the garment of the Lord, the Church of Christ? Christ himself warns and teaches in his Gospel, saying, "And there will be one flock and one shepherd" (John 10:16). Does anyone really think that there can be one flock or many shepherds in one place? The Apostle Paul also points to this same unity; he begs and exhorts, saying, "I appeal to you, brothers, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be united in the same mind and the same judgment" (1 Corinthians 1:10). And again he says, "Bearing with one another in love, eager to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace" (Ephesians 4:3). Do you think that someone who departs from the Church and establishes other seats and different dwellings for himself can stand and live, when it was said to Rahab, in whom the Church was prefigured: "Gather your father and your mother and your brothers and all your father's household to yourself in your house, and everyone who goes out of the door of your house outside will be guilty" (Joshua 6:23)? Likewise, the sacrament of the Passover contains nothing else in the law of Exodus than that the lamb, which is killed as a figure of Christ, is eaten in one house. God says, "It shall be eaten in one house; you shall not carry any of the flesh outside the house" (Exodus 12:46). The flesh of Christ and the sacred body of the Lord cannot be thrown outside, nor is there any other house for believers except the one Church. The Holy Spirit designates and announces this house, this hospitality of unity, saying in the Psalms, "God who makes the like-minded dwell in a house." In the house of God, in the Church of Christ, the like-minded dwell, and they persevere, harmonious and simple.
